section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and reviews its validation in Western and non-Western contexts, noting discrepancies in factor structure. The present study, referred to as 'the present study', aims to examine the BAS factor structure among Indonesian women and men, investigate gender and ethnic differences in body appreciation, and explore its association with BMI in this specific cultural context.
